classification.difficultyReason: Select and combine properties indicated by side marks and diagonals with triangle or quadrilateral sums, distinguishing supplementary and reflex exterior angles.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in these diagrams.

spec.description: Kite with single ticks on the left pair, double ticks on the right pair, reflex angles at the left and bottom, and the lower-right edge extended through the right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Left interior angle 110 degrees; right interior angle 40 degrees; equal opposite interior angles 105 degrees; bottom reflex angle 255 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 250 degrees, 140 degrees and x degrees appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The left interior angle is $360^{\circ}-250^{\circ}=110^{\circ}$. The right interior angle is $180^{\circ}-140^{\circ}=40^{\circ}$.

Let each of the equal top and bottom interior angles be $a$.
$$\begin{aligned}2a+110+40&=360\\2a&=210\\a&=105\\x&=360-105\\x&=255^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral with an isosceles upper triangle, a dashed construction diagonal, and the right 70-degree arc spanning the full quadrilateral interior angle.
spec.mathematics: Upper base angles are 40 degrees. Lower right angle is 30 degrees. Lower triangle has angles 70, 30 and x degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: The question retains 100 degrees, both supplied 70-degree labels and x degrees; no derived angles.

answer.worked:
The upper triangle is isosceles, so each base angle is $(180^{\circ}-100^{\circ})\div2=40^{\circ}$.

The lower triangle's right angle is $70^{\circ}-40^{\circ}=30^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}x+70+30&=180\\x+100&=180\\x&=80^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Concave quadrilateral with an inward notch, exterior reflex angle at the upper-right vertex, and both lower sides extended to show vertically opposite angles.
spec.mathematics: Upper-right interior angle is 30 degrees; lower interior angle is 65 degrees; notch interior angle is 360-x degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 20 degrees, 330 degrees, 65 degrees and the smaller notch angle x degrees are supplied.

answer.worked:
The upper-right interior angle is $360^{\circ}-330^{\circ}=30^{\circ}$. The lower interior angle is $65^{\circ}$ because vertically opposite angles are equal. The reflex interior angle at the notch is $(360-x)^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}20+30+65+(360-x)&=360\\475-x&=360\\x&=115^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Trapezium with horizontal parallel sides, matching rightward arrows and a dashed diagonal dividing the upper-left angle into x degrees and 71 degrees.
spec.mathematics: The co-interior angles on the left side sum to 180 degrees, so x+71+72=180.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 71 degrees, 72 degrees and x degrees appear.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles between parallel lines sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}x+71+72&=180\\x+143&=180\\x&=37^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Rhombus with double ticks on every side and two dashed diagonals. The 62-degree angle is between the left side and the rising diagonal; x is between the left side and the falling diagonal.
spec.mathematics: A rhombus's diagonals bisect its vertex angles. The lower-left angle is 124 degrees, the upper-left angle is 56 degrees, and x is 28 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 62-degree angle and x degrees appear.

answer.worked:
The diagonals of a rhombus bisect its angles. The lower-left interior angle is $2\times62^{\circ}=124^{\circ}$.

Adjacent interior angles of a rhombus sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}2x+124&=180\\2x&=56\\x&=28^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Kite with single ticks on the left pair, double ticks on the right pair and both dashed diagonals. The bottom x-degree arc spans the full interior angle across the vertical diagonal.
spec.mathematics: The left isosceles triangle has base angles 40 degrees. The top full interior angle is 40+71=111 degrees, equal to the bottom full interior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the full left angle of 100 degrees, the partial top angle of 71 degrees and the full bottom angle x degrees appear.

answer.worked:
The left triangle is isosceles, so its top and bottom angles are equal.
$$\begin{aligned}a&=\frac{180-100}{2}\\a&=40^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
The top and bottom interior angles of this kite are equal.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=40+71\\x&=111^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
